result.note: Wrote plan.md (3 phases, 14 Progress rows) and plan-brief.md for worktree-pr-only; change.md set to planned.
assumptions: Push and PR creation live in a new standalone open-pr.mjs run by the orchestrator, not in the router, so ADR-003 and ADR-010 router rules stay true (evidence: pr-comment.mjs precedent, ADR-006, AGENTS.md line 9)
The PR step is always on with no flag and no policy key, so no provenance drift
An existing PR is updated by the push only; its body is untouched; MERGED or CLOSED PRs get no new PR
A halted run's uncommitted edits are committed as chore(<id>): final run state and pushed; side refs under refs/agent-smith/ are not pushed
Push is never forced and writes no git config; a failure is printed loudly and never fails the run
isolation.require false stays; a non-isolated run is skipped loudly; removing the opt-out is left as an owner decision in ADR-017
The opt-in PR comment moves behind the PR step and posts from the run root using a new --pr <url> option; in archive runs it posts after the archive instead of before
Base branch is origin/HEAD unless --base is given
